item.title: Recommend a Workshop Ticket Policy
item.audience: the organiser of a six-session evening workshop
item.prompt_text: An evening workshop has six sessions and 20 seats in each. The organiser can sell passes for all six sessions or sell each session separately. Regular participants want the same seat each week, while people working changing shifts want to attend on the days they are free. Recommend a ticket policy that serves both groups, explain a likely drawback, and suggest one way to review the policy after the first month.
item.target_grammar: Modal suggestions; conditionals for released seats; although and whereas for trade-offs.
item.target_structure: Summarise the competing needs, specify a ticket split and release rule, then explain how to review it.

checklist.point: Give a specific recommendation that could be put in place.
Explain a drawback and how to manage it.
Identify one useful measure for the first month.
